theme: Light theme default for high-visibility field operations, with a bilingual (EN/ID) toggle.

typography.secondary_font: Roboto (Body text, data tables, and input fields)
rules: Use Poppins with tracking-tight for large headings.
Never use Inter or default Vercel fonts for headings.
Maintain tight line-height for headings and relaxed for body text.

colors.guidance: Avoid pure white for main app backgrounds; use #EEF2FA. Use #98A7D5 for primary buttons and active states. Status colors must be accessible.

visual_enhancers: Subtle 1px borders with shadow-sm for cards instead of deep shadows.
Use large faded dot-grid logomark (opacity-10) in the background of full-bleed periwinkle header sections.
Bento grid for dashboard summary widgets.

layouts.dashboard_admin: Sidebar navigation (collapsible). Dense data tables with horizontal scroll. Grid-cols-4 or grid-cols-12 based bento layouts for stats.
layouts.mobile_inspection_form: Single-column mobile-first flow. Large tap targets (min 44px) for field workers. Sticky bottom submit bar. 37 items should be split by category or use a scrollspy/progress indicator.

components.status_pill_group: A customized radio group behaving like segmented controls. Touch-friendly.
components.photo_upload: Camera-first area with large dashed border. Must show thumbnail upon capture.
components.recap_matrix: Matrix table with sticky first column (Truck ID) and sticky header (Dates). Use Shadcn Table but customize for horizontal overflow.
components.data_table: Shadcn Table customized with dense spacing for admin dashboard.

motion: Micro-interactions on status pill selection (scale up slightly).
Smooth transition for language toggle EN/ID.
Avoid heavy animations for field app; prioritize performance.
accessibility: Minimum 44x44px touch targets for mobile form.
High contrast ratios (3:1 minimum) for all text and status pills.
All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
instructions_to_main_agent: Use ONLY .js files for React components. DO NOT create .tsx files.
Always apply 'data-testid' to interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-btn').
NEVER use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or floating elements. Apply backdrop-blur-xl or solid bg with border.
Implement Shadcn UI for forms, dialogs, and tables. Ensure no default Vercel styles.
Add 'sonner' for toast notifications, configured to match the brand colors.
The Inspection form MUST be single-column and optimized for mobile, with fixed header/footer for navigation.

rules: No generic centered layouts. Use optical alignment.
Implement deep layered designs using z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism.
Avoid universal 'transition: all'. Apply specific transitions.
Include a visible EN/ID language toggle in the nav bar.
Dashboard tables must allow exporting via CSV.
